description: Record-pass for hap_hdr_smoke. Same flow but no goldenFilepath (emits hash without comparison) and a CaptureScreenshot for visual verification. Use this to seed tests/goldens/hap_hdr_smoke/frame_0.hash on initial bake, and to eyeball the captured PNG — ACES tone-mapped highlight on a constant ~4.0 HDR input should produce a uniform near-white frame (rolled-off, NOT pure white-clipped). Pure white (255) means the ACES ODT didn't engage (FP16 path broken or PSO mismatched). Any value in the 240-252 ballpark across all pixels is healthy.
